title: Continuous-time entropy bound unjustified (switch times continuous, not on a grid)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Theorem 'Imax-cont' bounds $H(\{s_i\}\mid K)\le \log\binom{\lfloor\tau/\delta\rfloor}{K}$ by claiming the minimal dwell time $\delta$ confines switch times to a grid of $\lfloor\tau/\delta\rfloor$ slots.

False: $\delta$ only forces $s_{i+1}-s_i\ge\delta$; switch times remain continuous-valued. The relevant object is a differential entropy of a continuous law (possibly $+\infty$ or sign-indefinite), and the chain $H(A)\le H(a_0)+H(K)+H(\{s_i\}\mid K)$ illegitimately mixes discrete and differential entropies. The finiteness conclusion is unsupported. A correct treatment uses the transfer-entropy RATE of the controlled marked point process with a switching-rate budget.
